query: select p.market,p.prediction_side,p.game_date,p.game_id,p.player_id,p.sportsbook_line,p.payload->>'modelProjection' projection,p.payload->'priceComparison' probabilities,p.payload->'quote' quote,p.payload->'modelSelection' selection,g.result_status,g.actual from worker_pregame_picks p left join worker_pregame_grades g on g.sport=p.sport and g.market=p.market and g.game_id=p.game_id and g.player_id=p.player_id where p.sport='nhl' and p.market in ('goals','assists') and p.game_date between '2026-11-01' and '2026-11-13' order by p.market,p.game_date,p.game_id,p.player_id;
